name: jcgcoach-firestore-auth
description: Reglas de Firestore y preparación de Auth. No despliega nada.

scripts.test: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-appjorgecgcoach "node --test auth/code-identity.test.js firestore/rules.test.js firestore/safe-save-rules.test.js scripts/migrate-client-auth.test.js"
scripts.test:seguridad: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-jcg-seguridad --config firebase.seguridad.json "node --test --test-concurrency=1 firestore/uid-entrenador.test.js firestore/exposicion.test.js firestore/catalogo.test.js firestore/storage-rules.test.js firestore/rules.test.js firestore/campos-cliente.test.js firestore/safe-save-rules.test.js firestore/congelado.test.js firestore/envio-cliente.test.js"
scripts.test:migracion: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project demo-appjorgecgcoach --config firebase.seguridad.json "node --test --test-concurrency=1 scripts/migracion-emulador.test.js scripts/apropiacion-emulador.test.js"
scripts.test:unidad: node --test shared/safe-save.test.js shared/client-catalog.test.js auth/code-identity.test.js scripts/migrate-client-auth.test.js negocio-avisos.test.js shared/negocio-alert-rules.test.js shared/job-report.test.js notify/notify.test.js shared/registro-logv.test.js shared/alta-codigo.test.js shared/campos-cliente.test.js
scripts.e2e:emulador: cd e2e && firebase emulators:start --only firestore --project demo-jcg-e2e --config firebase.e2e.json
scripts.e2e:emulador-lan: cd e2e && firebase emulators:start --only firestore --project demo-jcg-e2e --config firebase.e2e-lan.json
scripts.test:copias: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-jcg-copias --config firebase.copias.json "node --test --test-concurrency=1 scripts/copia-emulador.test.js scripts/copias-completas-emulador.test.js"
